audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer calls it 'Aegis (E) passive block' that 'negates your auto and Q returns'. It is Aegis Assault, an active 22s channel, and Riot's text says he is invulnerable to damage FROM THE FRONT — not omnidirectionally, and not passively.
audit.why: A player told it is a passive block plays as if Pantheon is immune whenever E is up. Knowing it is a 22-second active that only covers his front turns it into the longest punish window in his kit: step around him, or simply wait it out and trade while it recharges.
audit.corrected: Named Aegis Assault, described as a frontal 22s channel, in phases[3].why, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, spikes[0].text, early and wants.foe[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2] said only 'your passive shrugs the first CC' without naming what it shrugs, and Shield Vault's auto-reset is never mentioned.
audit.why: Shield Vault is Pantheon's only immobilize in lane, so Mundo's passive eats exactly one of them and drops a cannister to walk over — established from the other side in the mirror audit. Shield Vault is also flagged autoReset, so the visual tell is the attack wind-up, not the cast.
audit.corrected: Both stated in phases[2].why and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shield Vault listed at 14s; no other cooldowns given. content whys[4] says 'At level 6 Pantheon still owns the trade' while win[4], spikes[1] and mid all say the lane flips to Mundo at 6.
audit.why: Shield Vault is 13/12/11/10/9, Comet Spear 11/10.25/9.5/8.75/8, Aegis Assault 22/21/20/19/18, Grand Starfall 180/165/150. And the level-6 flip is the whole win condition of the page — whys[4] argued against its own chart row.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written in; whys[4] rewritten to state the flip with Grand Starfall's 180s and Comet Spear's 11s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 3 and 4-5 are marked 'Skill' in both layers, but content whys[2], whys[3], spikes[0], early and the packet chart all give those stages to Pantheon.
audit.why: Pantheon's damage is front-loaded and Mundo pays health for his own Q; nothing changes at 3 that helps Mundo. The flip is at 6, which the chart already has right.
audit.corrected: Levels 3 and 4-5 flipped to Pantheon in both layers as one chart edit.

edits.before: Full kit online and your passive shrugs the first CC. Cleaver poke plus E-empowered swats start the grind; never brawl while Shield Vault (Stun) is up.
edits.after: Your passive eats his first Shield Vault stun and drops a cannister — walk over it. After that the stun is real and Aegis Assault blocks what you throw.

edits.before: Q ranks make the cleaver chunk real HP and your passive regen ramps. Pantheon must kill you through the sustain or watch you out-scale — most can't.
edits.after: Aegis Assault blocks damage only from the FRONT and runs 22s at rank 1 — step around him or wait it out, then trade while it is recharging.

edits.before: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun) (14s): matchup-defining — His all-in start. Bait it. Track it before every commit. - Your ultimate: spend it on kill windows, never on waves. - Summoners: track his Flash after any close call — it changes every dive call.
edits.after: - Shield Vault (13s at rank 1): his all-in start, and an auto-reset — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast. Your passive eats the first one. - Aegis Assault (22s) blocks only from the front; step around it. - Grand Starfall is 180s at rank 1.

edits.before: Track Pantheon’s Shield Vault (Stun) (14s): His all-in start. Bait it. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Shield Vault (13s at rank 1) starts his all-in; Aegis Assault (22s) blocks only from the front — walk around it.

edits.before: At level 6 Pantheon still owns the trade — his point-and-click W stun into Q spam and Grand Starfall threat burst you down before Maximum Dosage heal can turn the extended fight.
edits.after: At 6 Maximum Dosage out-lasts his burst: Comet Spear is 11s at rank 1 and Grand Starfall (180s) is a map tool, not a duel button — the long trade is yours.

edits.before: Pantheon dominates early: his Comet Spear (Q) poke and Shield Vault (W) stun let him all-in you repeatedly, and his Aegis (E) passive block negates your auto and Q returns, so you bleed health every trade and just want to farm safe.
edits.after: Pantheon dominates early: Comet Spear (Q) poke and a Shield Vault (W) stun let him all-in you, and Aegis Assault (E) blocks damage from the front for its whole channel. Your passive eats the first stun only — after that, farm safe.

edits.before: Pantheon owns levels 1-4: Comet Spear (Q) poke, a Shield Vault (W) point-and-click stun, and Aegis (E) that blocks your auto and Q damage mean he wins every early trade while you can't afford to fight back.
edits.after: Pantheon owns levels 1-4: Comet Spear (Q) poke, a point-and-click Shield Vault (W) stun, and Aegis Assault (E), which blocks damage from the front — not from behind. He wins every early trade; do not fund it.

edits.before: Block your autos and Q with Aegis (E) to win every early trade
edits.after: Face you with Aegis Assault (E) — it only blocks the front

edits.before: Bait Aegis (E) and Shield Vault (W) before you commit
edits.after: Bait Aegis Assault (E), then commit from behind him

notes: IMPORTANT — the _missing-interactions entry for this matchup claims 'Pantheon's Aegis Assault (E) is a channel — your Goes Where He Pleases (P) cancels it outright.' That is backwards and I did NOT write it: Dr. Mundo's passive RESISTS an incoming immobilize, it does not apply CC, so it cannot interrupt anything. The mirror audit (pantheon__drmundo) reached the same conclusion independently. The rule likely needs fixing in the generator, since it will keep emitting this claim for every Mundo matchup against a channel. Reused from the mirror: the passive-eats-first-Shield-Vault read and the Heart Zapper bait, kept consistent in direction.
